title: Old Application Pods Failed on Dropped DB Column During Rolling Deploy
failure: Old application instances still running during rolling deployment referenced removed database columns, causing immediate query crashes.
impact: Spike in HTTP 500 errors and degraded transaction processing during rolling release window.

title: Unbounded External API Latency Cascading to Thread Pool Starvation
failure: Synchronous call to external provider lacked request timeouts; downstream provider degraded, holding worker threads and starving incoming requests.
impact: Global service latency spike to 45s, worker starvation, cascading gateway 504 timeouts.

title: Single Replica Downtime During Container Re-creation
failure: Service scaled down to replica count 1 lost zero-downtime rolling guarantees. During image pull and cold start, no instances served traffic.
impact: 100% downtime for 3.5 minutes on critical user endpoints during deployment.

title: Major SDK Upgrade Introduced Breaking Runtime Parameter Mismatch
failure: Major payment SDK version upgrade altered webhook signature verification and error response types; passed unit mocks but failed live callbacks.
impact: Payment webhook failures, customer checkout lockup for 40 minutes.

title: Unbounded Query on New Endpoint Caused Memory Exhaustion Under Traffic
failure: New API endpoint performed full-table scanning without pagination. At 50 QPS in production, memory footprint exploded causing Linux OOM killer invocation.
impact: Repeated container OOMKilled crashes and cluster-wide memory thrashing.

title: Connection Pool Exhaustion After Worker Concurrency Increase
failure: Increased worker threads without proportional database max_connections limit, causing Postgres 'too many clients already' errors.
impact: Database refused new connections; all API read/write operations stalled.

title: NOT NULL Constraint Added Without Default Broken Existing Writes
failure: Migration added a NOT NULL constraint without default value before the application began writing the new field.
impact: All incoming insert operations failed with database constraint violations.

title: Retry Storm Amplification Triggered Downstream Cascading Outage
failure: Aggressive client-side retries with exponential backoff removed amplified requests by 5x during minor network hiccup, overwhelming downstream API.

title: Readiness Probe Timeout Misconfiguration Caused Routing Flapping
failure: Readiness probe endpoint pointed to a heavy DB query with a 1s timeout; minor DB query latency led Kubernetes to pull healthy pods from service endpoints.
impact: Traffic dropped to zero healthy endpoints despite application running normally.

title: Autoscaling Limit Reduction Caused Pod Saturation During Marketing Event
failure: Deployment manifest reduced maxReplicas and CPU limits to cut costs; sudden traffic influx pinned CPU at 100% with no autoscaling headroom.
impact: Severe request latency degradation and queue drops for 2 hours.
